Bitcoin Freed Money. SmartHoldem Frees the Internet

Why Web 4.0 Is the Real Evolution of Digital Sovereignty

When Bitcoin emerged in 2009, it solved one fundamental problem: how to transfer value without trusting a central authority. It introduced decentralized consensus, digital scarcity, and the idea that “code is law.”

Fifteen years later, the crypto industry has delivered DeFi, NFTs, and DAOs. Yet it has failed to solve the most critical challenge of all - building a truly decentralized internet.

Today, the vast majority of so-called decentralized applications still rely on AWS, Cloudflare, and Vercel. A single court order can erase a dApp’s frontend. A Terms of Service violation can shut down an entire project. The backend may be free, but the door to that backend is still owned by corporations.

This is the Frontend Paradox of Web3. And it is why the real question is no longer “Can SmartHoldem become the next Bitcoin?” but rather:

Is SmartHoldem the next logical step after Bitcoin?

Bitcoin Was Layer 0. SmartHoldem Is Layer Everything

Bitcoin and SmartHoldem are not competitors. They solve different problems at different layers of the stack.

- Bitcoin decentralized money. It gave the world a trustless store of value and a settlement layer.
- Ethereum decentralized computation. It introduced smart contracts and programmable money.
- SmartHoldem Netfory OS decentralizes physical infrastructure. It delivers a sovereign internet where users, not corporations, own hosting, communication, and identity.

Bitcoin proved that a network could survive without a CEO.  
SmartHoldem proves that an entire internet can survive without a cloud provider.

The Three Pillars That Make SmartHoldem Different

 1. Physical Decentralization, Not Just Ledger Decentralization

Most blockchains only decentralize the ledger. Applications, websites, and data still live on centralized servers.

SmartHoldem goes further. Through the Netfory Web 4.0 OS, every user with a spare hard drive or VPS can become a Seeder - a node that stores content, routes traffic, and hosts applications.

No AWS account to hack.  
No Cloudflare project to delete.  
No Vercel deployment to revoke.

Content is addressed via BLAKE3 hashes and distributed across a dynamic swarm. If one node goes offline, thousands of others keep the data alive. This is the architecture of a digital lifeboat.

 2. Proof-of-Utility, Not Proof-of-Speculation

Bitcoin’s security comes from energy-intensive mining. Ethereum’s comes from staked capital. Both are valid, but neither directly rewards useful work.

SmartHoldem introduces Proof-of-Utility. Seeders earn STH based on real contributions: storage provided, bandwidth delivered, and uptime maintained.

The transparent formula is:

`(Base + seededGb × density + activeApps × PerApp) × K_up`

This creates a self-sustaining economy where participants are rewarded for actual infrastructure work. It is the economic engine of a true Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Network (DePIN).

3. LAN-First Resilience: Survival When the World Goes Dark

In a world of fiber cuts, regional blackouts, and internet shutdowns, traditional networks, including Bitcoin and Ethereum, fail. They require global connectivity to function.

Netfory is designed with a LAN-First paradigm. When the global connection drops, clients automatically switch to local peer discovery via mDNS. Your local network becomes a sovereign island:

- E2EE chats continue between neighbors
- File sharing via CID works at full speed
- Cached dApps remain fully functional

This is not just a technical feature. It is a human rights feature. In regions where governments shut down the internet, Netfory keeps communities connected.

The Deflationary Model: Why STH Is Not Just Another Coin

Bitcoin’s supply is capped at 21 million. SmartHoldem took a different path: block emission has been completely halted.

The STH coin is now strictly deflationary. Supply decreases over time through burning mechanisms for:

Every time a developer registers a `u://` name, a user sends an anti-spam invite via 0xID Mail, or a dApp is published to DevHub, STH is burned. The more the network is used, the scarcer the token becomes.

Reputation Over Censorship

One of the biggest questions about decentralized networks is: “How do you stop scams and malware?”

SmartHoldem’s answer is Reputation over Censorship. The platform uses a two-tier catalog system:

- Official - Apps verified by cryptographic signatures from trusted developers
- All - The full, unfiltered P2P network

We mark. We never censor. Direct `sn://` links always work. By default, users see a safe, verified environment. This balances safety with absolute freedom, something no centralized platform can achieve.

So, Can SmartHoldem Become the Next Bitcoin?

The question is framed incorrectly.

SmartHoldem is not trying to replace Bitcoin. It is trying to complete what Bitcoin started.

Bitcoin freed money from central banks.

Bitcoin gave us digital gold.

title: The Web 3.0 Illusion
text: Why Web4 cannot be Web3 + AI, and why only Physical P2P can deliver true decentralization.
article:
The Web3 Illusion

Why the Crypto Industry is Becoming a Hostage of Corporations and How Physical P2P Saves It

We are living through a paradox.  
On one hand, we have decentralized blockchains like Ethereum and Solana processing billions in value without a central authority.  

On the other hand, the applications we use to interact with these chains - Uniswap, OpenSea, Lens Protocol are hosted on AWS, served via Cloudflare, and deployed through Vercel.

This is the Frontend Paradox of Web3. And it makes the entire industry a hostage of corporate infrastructure.

The Fatal Flaw of “Decentralized” Apps

Imagine you build a censorship-resistant social media dApp. Your smart contracts are immutable. Your data is on IPFS.  

But your frontend? It’s a React app sitting on an Amazon S3 bucket.

All it takes is:
- A single court order sent to AWS  
- A Terms of Service violation detected by Cloudflare  
- A government firewall blocking the domain  

And just like that, your “decentralized” application vanishes from the internet for 99% of users. The backend is free, but the door to the backend is locked by a corporation.

We saw this happen with many Web3 frontends. 

If you don’t own the transport layer, you don’t own your application.

Why IPFS and Tor Didn’t Solve It

You might ask: “Why not just host on IPFS or use Tor?”

They are great tools, but they weren’t built for the modern web application stack.

IPFS is excellent for static content, but it struggles with dynamic state, real-time updates, and human-readable addressing at scale.  

Tor provides anonymity, but sacrifices performance, making it unusable for complex dApps or real-time communication.

Neither has a native economic model to incentivize high-availability hosting. They rely on altruism, which doesn’t scale against corporate reliability.

Enter Web 4.0: The Decentralized Physical Internet

Web 4.0 isn’t just a buzzword. It’s the next architectural evolution where the network itself becomes the infrastructure.

Instead of renting servers from Amazon, we use a sovereign Peer-to-Peer network powered by user-owned hardware.

This is what we are building with Netfory and SmartHoldem.

1. Zero-Infrastructure Architecture

In Netfory, there is no traditional “backend”. There is no AWS account to hack and no Vercel project to delete. Applications deploy directly to the P2P network.

 2. Content-Addressability Everywhere

We don’t use domains that can be seized. We use BLAKE3 Content Identifiers. Content proves itself.

 3. Iroh (QUIC) Transport

We replaced slow TCP-based P2P with Iroh, built on QUIC. This enables direct device-to-device connections, low latency, and better resistance to blocking.

The Economic Loop: Proof-of-Utility

Altruism doesn’t keep servers running. Economics do.

In the Netfory ecosystem, participants who provide storage and bandwidth (Seeders) are compensated in $STH through a Proof-of-Utility mechanism. Rewards are tied to real utility: uptime, data volume, and active apps.

This creates a self-sustaining market for infrastructure.

Reputation Over Censorship

Critics often ask: “If it’s fully open, how do you stop scams and malware?”

The answer is Reputation, not Censorship.

Netfory uses a two-tier catalog system:
- Official - apps verified by cryptographic signatures  
- All - the full, unfiltered P2P network  

We mark. We don’t censor.

The End of Renting Access

For the last 20 years we’ve been renting access to the internet.  

Web 4.0 changes this. It turns every user with a spare hard drive into a node of a global, uncensorable cloud.

Developers get true independence.  
Users get privacy and ownership.  
Seeders get passive income.

The era of corporate hostages is ending.  
The era of the Sovereign Web has begun.

text: From Hex Codes to Living Worlds: How SmartHoldem Turned the Blockchain into a Procedural Universe.
article:
From Hex Codes to Living Worlds: How SmartHoldem Turned the Blockchain into a Procedural Universe.

Today, we are proud to introduce SmartHoldem Cosmic Sandbox - a decentralized, procedural 3D universe where every on-chain action shapes a unique world. We built it entirely with open-source web technologies, zero backend, and pure cryptographic DNA. This is not just a visualizer; it’s a new way to experience the blockchain.

At SmartHoldem, our team of engineers and designers asked a different question: What if your wallet wasn’t just a string of characters, but a living, breathing planet?

🧬 The Core Concept: Address = DNA

The magic of Cosmic Sandbox starts with determinism. In a decentralized world, trust comes from reproducibility. We didn’t want a centralized database where we manually assign “cool planets” to whales. We wanted math to decide.

Every SmartHoldem address (starting with S…) is hashed using SHA-256. This generates a unique 32-byte “DNA” sequence. From these bytes, we extract everything that defines a world:

  • Biome: Volcanic Magma, Glacial Ice, Desert Sandstone, Forest Terra, or Cyber-Grid.

  • Terrain: The amplitude and frequency of mountains, craters, and oceans using FBm OpenSimplex2 noise.

  • Atmosphere: Cloud density, ring tilt, and ocean color.

This means that if you enter the same address on any device, anywhere in the world, you will see the exact same planet. Bit-for-bit. No servers, no manipulation. Just pure cryptography meeting WebGL.

🐗 Meet Veipr: The Biomechanical Boar

A static planet is beautiful, but a living world is engaging. That’s why we introduced Veipr - biomechanical boars that inhabit every planet.

  • Population: Determined by transaction activity (1–3 boars per world).

  • Alpha-Veipr: Holders with >100k STH get an armored, cyber-enhanced Alpha-Veipr with mechanical fangs derived from their wallet’s DNA bytes.

  • AI Movement: Veiprs don’t teleport. They use spherical wander AI, calculating displacement over the noise-generated terrain so they walk over hills rather than through them.

  • When a new transaction hits the blockchain, the network comes alive. A rocket or UFO crashes into the planet’s surface with a particle burst, and your Veipr sprints across the landscape to the impact zone, leaving neon sparks in its wake. It’s a visual confirmation of value transfer that feels like a game, not a ledger.

    Using our Photo Mode, users can capture their planet and export a 1080x1920 poster optimized for Instagram and Telegram Stories. Embedded in every poster is a scannable QR code with a deep link.

    When a friend scans that code, they don’t just go to a homepage - they teleport directly to your specific planet. This creates a viral loop where every shared image brings a new user into the SmartHoldem ecosystem without a single line of ad copy.

🛠 Under the Hood: Vue 3 + TresJS

Why TresJS? Because TresJS offers a declarative approach that feels native to Vue. Instead of managing a complex renderer.render() loops manually, our scene becomes part of the reactive component tree. Tags like <TresPerspectiveCamera> and <TresAmbientLight> allow us to treat 3D objects as HTML elements.

The Tech Stack:

  • Frontend: Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript + TailwindCSS.

  • 3D Engine: TresJS (Declarative Three.js) + Three.js.

  • Procedural Gen: fastnoise-lite for high-performance noise generation.

  • State Management: Pinia.

  • Blockchain Interaction: Direct fetch calls to public SmartHoldem nodes (node1.smartholdem.io). Zero backend proxy.

One of the biggest technical challenges was integrating Three.js with Vue’s reactivity system. Wrapping a THREE.Scene in a Vue ref() causes deep-proxy issues that break shaders. The solution? Using markRaw() and shallowRef() to tell Vue: "Don't touch this object, it’s mine." This simple pattern saved us days of debugging and ensured buttery-smooth performance.

🌍 Ready for 2026: Zero-Click & PWA

Modern search is moving toward Zero-Click results and Generative AI. To stay ahead, Cosmic Sandbox is built as a Progressive Web App (PWA). It installs natively on mobile devices, works offline via service workers, and runs in full screen without browser borders.

We are also updating the main SmartHoldem website with advanced microdata and schema markup, ensuring that our decentralized infrastructure is easily understood by the neural ecosystems of 2026’s search algorithms.

🚀 Join the Universe

SmartHoldem Cosmic Sandbox is more than a tool; it’s a statement. It proves that blockchain technology can be both technically robust and emotionally resonant. It turns cold data into warm, living worlds.

Ready to find your planet?

  1. Visit https://planet.smartholdem.io

  2. Enter your STH address or connect via the SmartHoldem Wallet extension.

  3. Explore your biome, feed your Veipr, and share your cosmic QR code.

The universe is waiting.

The Power of Focus

We are not building a new chain. We are supercharging the one that already works.

In contrast, our main DPoS network has completely stopped emissions. No new STH coins are being created. This makes STH a scarce, deflationary asset.

You don’t farm "noise." You host useful data (encrypted clouds, dApps, private mail). The proof of this storage is anchored to the main DPoS chain. Rewards are paid in STH - the only token in the ecosystem. Since no new STH is emitted, these rewards come from transaction fees and service usage, creating a sustainable, deflationary economy.

3. Quantum Resistance: One Shield, Total Protection

Security is our priority. By consolidating into a single DPoS chain, we are accelerating the development of our Quantum-Resistant Cryptography.

Conclusion

We chose quality over quantity. Security over complexity. Utility over speculation.
By abandoning the dead-end Chia fork, we have freed ourselves to build what matters: a fast, quantum-resistant, and uncensorable internet powered by the most efficient DPoS blockchain in the industry.

🛡️ SmartHoldem: Quantum Shield. How We Protect the Blockchain from Future Computers.

While the market discusses charts and volatility, a threat capable of nullifying classical cryptography is maturing in the labs of tech giants. Shor's algorithm on a sufficiently powerful quantum computer could break ECDSA (elliptic curves) - the mathematical foundation on which wallets and transactions for most blockchains, including SmartHoldem, are built today.

We aren't waiting for a hypothetical "Day X." The integration of Post-Quantum Cryptography (PQC) into the SmartHoldem ecosystem has already begun. Below is a detailed breakdown of our roadmap for the post-quantum era.

 1. What is the main vulnerability of modern networks?

Blockchain cryptography relies on one-way functions: it's easy to generate a public key from a private one, but practically impossible to reverse on classical computers. Quantum algorithms break this paradigm. If a malicious actor gains access to a sufficiently powerful quantum stack, the key generation mechanism becomes "transparent." Under these conditions, even a strong passphrase won't save you, as the vulnerability lies in the mathematical basis itself, not in user data.

2. The Arsenal: Which algorithms are we choosing?

Developing cryptography from scratch is an unjustified risk without years of independent audit. SmartHoldem is aligning with finalists from the NIST standardization competition and time-tested schemes:

 3. Implementation Plan: Hybrid Model

We are ruling out abrupt hard forks and forced migrations. The transition will be gradual and seamless:
Stage 1: Hybrid Signatures
Transactions will be signed simultaneously with classic ECDSA and a new PQC algorithm (e.g., Dilithium). Even if one method is compromised, the other will maintain protection.
Stage 2: Updating STH-Core
Since the SmartHoldem node is written in TypeScript/Node.js, we will integrate optimized PQC libraries in Rust or C++ via node-addon-api. This maintains the high throughput of the DPoS network without sacrificing cryptographic strength.
Stage 3: Quantum Addresses
Introduction of a new address type with extended public keys resistant to quantum analysis. Users will be able to gradually transfer funds to "Quantum-Safe" wallets.

 4. Killer Feature: Hybrid Quantum Shield via Second Signature

Unlike many networks where users would have to create new wallets and mass-transfer assets, SmartHoldem leverages a unique architectural feature — the second signature mechanism.

How it works:
- An address in SmartHoldem is formed as a hash of the first public key.
- When the second signature is activated, a second public key is recorded on the blockchain.
- We replace the generation of this second key from ECDSA with a post-quantum algorithm.

Result: You do not need to change your wallet. When you activate the second passphrase, the system automatically applies a "post-quantum lock" to your account. Your address remains the same, your coins stay exactly where they have been for years, but now they are protected by a second cryptographic layer. Even if a quantum computer computes your first private key, it cannot send a transaction without a valid second (quantum-resistant) signature. The SmartHoldem node will simply reject the attempt.

 For users on a single signature: You will need to either activate a second signature (which instantly enables quantum protection) or transfer funds to the new address types once they are released.

5. Technical Nuances & Network Protection

- Delegates under protection: In a DPoS network, delegates sign blocks. Forging their signatures threatens the entire blockchain's integrity. Implementing PQC at the protocol level makes SmartHoldem a "digital fortress" resistant to consensus spoofing.
- Transaction size: Hash-based schemes (Lamport/SPHINCS+) generate signatures sized in kilobytes. Node logic will be adapted to correctly process "heavy" transactions without losing sync speed.
- OTS Optimization: To avoid bloating the blockchain, one-time keys will be aggregated into Merkle trees. For the user, this looks like a familiar wallet, but at the mathematical level, each key is used strictly once and invalidated after signing.

Quantum supremacy is not the end of cryptography, but its next evolutionary stage. 

SmartHoldem isn't adapting retroactively. We are laying the foundation for the future today. We are choosing mathematics that cannot be "solved" by brute force and integrating it directly into the core of our DPoS network.
 

The future is already here. And it is secured.

TechnoL0g: That's an excellent question. SmartHoldem ($STH) is a specialized powerhouse for Web3 gaming and beyond. Here’s a breakdown of its unique advantages and how they tackle industry pain points:

Unmatched Scale for Gaming & dApps:

While many blockchains struggle with speed and cost, SmartHoldem's core engine is designed for massive demand. Its ability to process over 5 billion transactions daily directly solves the scalability bottleneck that plagues many platforms. This means games can run smoothly with thousands of simultaneous players without congestion or exorbitant fees - a game-changer for the industry.

Below, I will attach a table of the public test results for the scalability of the Smartholdem blockchain.



 A Developer-First Economy:

On most platforms, a significant portion of transaction fees (gas) is captured by the network itself. SmartHoldem flips this model with its Developer-Friendly Economy. Cashback from fees generated by a DApp or game goes directly to its creator, not just to validators. This directly resolves the monetization problem for developers, making it far more sustainable to build and innovate on our platform.

Moving Beyond Just Smart Contracts:

Instead of relying solely on complex smart contracts for every function, SmartHoldem introduces new built-in transaction types, TRNG (True Random Number Generator) services, and ZKP (Zero-Knowledge Proof) functions. This makes development more accessible using popular programming languages, reduces potential bugs and costs, and is especially perfect for creating provably fair games where randomness and fairness are verifiable on-chain.

Commitment to Provably Fair Gaming:

This is at the heart of the STH mission. The blockchain ensures that every game result is truly random and free from manipulation by humans or central authorities. This builds unprecedented trust in online gaming and iGaming, offering a transparent alternative to traditional "black box" systems.

Sustainable and Fixed Tokenomics:

The $STH coin has a fixed supply with no new emissions ever. This means no new coins are created, protecting holders from inflation and aligning long-term value with the growth and adoption of the network itself. Value accrues from utility, not dilution. We’re not just building a blockchain, we’re creating a foundation for entirely new business models where developers are properly rewarded, games are inherently fair, and scalability is never a limitation. It’s about solving the real-world problems developers and businesses face today.

On Ethereum, this would cost millions in gas. On SmartHoldem, it costs much less and happens instantly. This unlocks High-Frequency Services, such as our future decentralized VPN and lottery platforms.

Our TRNG is not a black box or an external oracle that can be bribed. SmartHoldem TRNG is a native blockchain function. 

We use the hashes of future blocks, combined with network entropy, to produce a result that is mathematically unpredictable and verifiable by any user. As I like to say: "Not even a time traveler will know the result of the hand before the block is generated." 

This is critical for our Poker Room, lotteries, and other DApps. We guarantee mathematically provable fairness, ensuring no one can influence the outcome. Our TRNG is resilient, even against time travelers.

The burn occurs when a transaction is sent at the node level. This does not affect the user's balance and is invisible to them. For network validators, at first glance, they receive a smaller fee due to the burn, but as the asset's value increases, that fee becomes more valuable.

Deflationary model with limited emission: 

The deflationary model will reduce the total supply of the SmartHoldem STH cryptocurrency and determine the circulating supply: Min 100M – Max 150M STH.   • Fully Automated & Player-Owned

  • Tournament Creation & Manager Earnings

  • Each manager's profit depends on how many tickets he sells for the tournament. Usually, many more tickets are sold than the tournament's announced guaranteed pot.   • Built on SmartHoldem’s Efficient Blockchain. The underlying blockchain is designed for low-cost, high-speed transactions. The 1 STH fee per hand ensures the network remains secure and operational while keeping costs symbolic and fair.

Because your game account is your own blockchain wallet, you control your keys and your funds. This removes the need for costly customer support, dispute resolution, and centralized finance teams—further reducing operational burdens.

Introducing Steganography in SmartHoldem Wallet!
🔒 Hide secrets in plain sight!

We’ve just added a powerful new feature to the SmartHoldem Wallet - STEGANOGRAPHY,

and it’s now live at:  https://wallet.smartholdem.io

Imagine you could send a friend a seemingly ordinary picture of a cat, with a secret message hidden inside that only they can see. Sounds like something out of a spy movie? Not at all! This is steganography - an ancient art and modern science of concealing information. Unlike cryptography, which encrypts a message to make it unreadable, steganography hides the very existence of the message.

In our wallet, we use one of the most elegant steganography methods, the LSB (Least Significant Bit) method.

 What Can You Use It For?
The possibilities are limited only by your imagination:

Secure Data Storage: Hide private keys, seed phrases, or important passwords inside your personal photos. No one would ever guess that your vacation selfie encrypts access to a crypto wallet.
Secret Correspondence: Exchange messages with friends or colleagues without fear of interception or reading. Send memes that mean more than they seem.
Digital Watermarks: If you're an artist, photographer, or content creator, you can embed an invisible signature (name, date, website link) directly into your work. This will help prove your authorship if someone tries to steal it.
Quests and Puzzles (ARGs): Creators of alternate reality games can hide clues and keys in images that players must "scan" with our tool.

How to create a secret image?

  1. Open SmartHoldem wallet https://wallet.smartholdem.io
  2. Select Steganography tool 
  3. Upload image 
  4. Enter data to embed
  5. Click on Embed Data
  6. Done! Download image!

If you want to Extract Data, click Extract Data, then upload a Steganography image.

Important! All of this happens locally in your browser! Your secrets stay with you.

You can also encrypt your image with an AES-based password. Only those with the password can decrypt it and discover the hidden secret.

How Does a Picture Turn into a Secret Container?

1. Pixel Magic: Any digital image consists of thousands or millions of tiny dots called pixels. The color of each pixel is described by a set of three numbers: R (red), G (green), and B (blue). Sometimes a fourth, A (alpha channel), is added for transparency. Each of these numbers has a value from 0 to 255.

2. The Secret in the Last Bit: In the binary system, the number 255 looks like 11111111. The rightmost bit in this chain is our "least significant bit" (LSB). Changing it—for example, from 11111111 (255) to 11111110 (254)—is so negligible that the human eye simply won't notice the color difference. The pixel remains virtually the same!

3. The "Embedding" Process: We take your secret text and convert it into a sequence of zeros and ones (bits).
To let the recipient know where the message ends, we first write its length into the picture (the first 32 bits are used for this).
Then, our algorithm carefully, one by one, replaces the least significant bit in each color component (R, G, B, A) of each pixel with a bit from your message. This process continues until the entire message is "dissolved" into the image. In the end, you get a regular PNG picture that doesn't arouse suspicion but holds your secret. We use the PNG format because it doesn't compress images with loss, keeping our hidden data intact.

A vanity address is a cryptocurrency address that contains a specific, user-defined sequence of characters in a particular position. Unlike randomly generated addresses, vanity addresses allow users to create memorable or branded wallet addresses.

Security

Cryptographically Secure Randomness: The generation of the mnemonic phrase relies on the bip39 library, which uses Node.js's built-in crypto.randomBytes module. It is a Cryptographically Secure Pseudo-Random Number Generator (CSPRNG), ensuring that the initial entropy for your key is of high quality and unpredictable.

Industry-Standard Cryptography:  The address and key pair are derived from the mnemonic phrase using the official @smartholdem/crypto library. This library implements the same robust and widely-trusted secp256k1 elliptic curve cryptography that secures major cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin and Ethereum.

No Data Persistence: All sensitive data exists only in memory and console output. This tool does not save or transmit any data. The generated address and its corresponding secret mnemonic phrase are only displayed in your console. You are in complete control, and it is your responsibility to store the secret phrase in a secure place.

Q2: Could you provide us with a detailed breakdown of SmartHoldem? We’re interested in understanding the distribution and allocation of tokens, including any details on supply, vesting schedules, and how the tokens are utilized within the ecosystem.

To answer your question, I need to tell you how the platform's history began.

SmartHoldem was founded in late 2017 and raised $170k in Bitcoin and other cryptos through an initial distribution. The distribution was overseen by the reputable Escrows of the BitcoinTalk forum, who were selected by members of the SmartHoldem community. All funds raised were held by Escrow and were paid out as the roadmap items were completed. During the initial distribution, 83% of the total STH supply was allocated to SmartHoldem ICO participants, 8% to advisors and angels, 3% to Bounty campaign participants, and 6% was reserved in the Dev fund.

SmartHoldem launched its Mainnet on December 14, 2017, with 240M SmartHoldem STH coins created at Genesis.

The SmartHoldem blockchain was updated to version 2.0 in August 2023. After two years of dedicated development, our team has successfully launched the innovative SmartHoldem gaming blockchain. SmartHoldem 2.0 is a next-generation open-source hybrid blockchain platform based on the world's first consensus mechanism with a unique combination of Delegated Proof of Stake (DPoS) and Proof of SpaceTime (PoSt) algorithms.

After the global update 2.0 of the platform infrastructure, SmartHoldem has transitioned from an Inflationary model with limited emission to a Deflationary model with limited emission.

Emission in DPoS SmartHoldem L1 has been completely stopped. The deflationary model will reduce the total supply of the SmartHoldem STH cryptocurrency and determine the circulating supply: Min 100,000,000 STH - Max 150,000,000 STH. The SmartHoldem DPoS network has a deflationary mechanism that burns 50% of blockchain fees.
When the total supply is reduced to 100,000,000 STH, the DPoS network will stop burning 50% of the fees. Once the total supply reaches 150,000,000 STH on the DPoS blockchain, the 50% fee burn protocol will be activated. So, the STH value increases, and supply decreases.

Delegated Proof of Stake (DPOS) is a blockchain consensus mechanism in which network users vote and select delegates to verify blocks.

SmartHoldem Delegates

According to the Delegated Proof of Stake (DPOS) algorithm, the top 21 delegates check transactions every 8 seconds, create new blocks, maintain the SmartHoldem network, and receive rewards for each signed block.

There can only be 21 active delegates in SmartHoldem DPOS; other registered delegates are on standby. They can replace active delegates who have gone offline and join the top 21 active delegates.

The delegate system is highly competitive because a delegate can move into or out of the top position of the Top 21 at any time. This sustainable scheme allows new delegates to prove themselves, gain the community's attention, and enter the Top 21 anytime if the community votes a new delegate into an active position.

Delegate Rewards

The delegate who signs the block receives ALL NETWORK FEES for the block's transactions. Different transactions have their fees on the Smartholdem blockchain. For example, if a block contains 500 standard transactions, the delegate will earn up to 500 STH. If the block includes no transactions, the delegate will earn nothing for that block. If the block contains a delegate registration transaction, the delegate will earn 10,000 STH.

The list of fees on the SmartHoldem blockchain https://wallet.smartholdem.io/blockchain/ .

SmartHoldem DPoS blockchain includes new transaction types such as multiple payments, gaming transactions, multi-signatures, crypto-signatures, second passphrase, burn transactions, registration transactions, IPFS hash transactions, hashed time-locked contract (HTLC), Zero-Knowledge Proofs transactions, delegate resignation, and copyright registration.

Read More - SmartHoldem 2.0: Blockchain Innovations.
There is no emission in the SmartHoldem blockchain level 1 (DPOS). There are no additional rewards other than transaction fees. SmartHoldem has a developer fund and you can offer your application on the SmartHoldem blockchain and qualify for rewards from the fund.

Become a SmartHoldem delegate:

Anyone can become a SmartHoldem delegate.
All you need is a reliable server and active participation in the SmartHoldem community.

Delegates are highly valued for their crucial role in securing the SmartHoldem registry. Elected delegates represent SmartHoldem coin holders by suggesting ideas or changes to the network and contributing to the improvement of the ecosystem.

Anyone can manage a SmartHoldem node and register a delegate. However, only delegates in the top 21 can form (create) new blocks and get rewarded in SmartHoldem STH.

One of the reasons to become a SmartHoldem delegate is to be part of an innovative and cutting-edge team and to be rewarded and highly respected in our community for their critical functions.

Getting started with SmartHoldem is easy with step-by-step guides and a supportive community for everyone, regardless of their technical background.

Connect with the community

For a delegate, active participation and connection to the community is vital to gaining votes.

Generating delegate slots is competitive and requires more than just managing a node. Creating new applications based on SmartHoldem, and offering additional services such as code validation, vulnerability reports or community outreach can make the difference between a vote for or against.

You can also offer voters a percentage of the rewards to get the necessary votes to reach the Top 21. After voting for a Delegate, the voter receives a portion of the Delegate's reward as a reward for voting.
The reward is measured based on the voter's share of participation, the number of votes, and the percentage of payoffs established by the Delegate.

To become a Delegate, follow the instructions on our GitHub

text: SmartHoldem 2.0: Blockchain technology innovations. We are pleased to announce the launch of a series of SmartHoldem 2.0 updates.

SmartHoldem 2.0: Blockchain technology innovations

SmartHoldem 2.0 is the beginning of a new era. We strive for innovation and our approach to development has been methodical and balanced. We’ve abandoned quick fixes and taken the path that will lead us to real change.

We are pleased to announce the launch of a series of SmartHoldem 2.0 updates. These fundamental updates place SmartHoldem at the forefront of innovation in the emerging blockchain technology ecosystem.

Everything we do aims to provide accessibility. We are building a future where everyone can use crypto and benefit from Web3. We believe that innovation should be safe for our planet, so we focus on green technologies.

SmartHoldem 2.0 offers unique features and benefits. We provide tools to help you fully take advantage of blockchain technologies' potential. We are building a decentralized platform where everyone can participate and contribute to the development of the ecosystem.

Our team is working hard to make SmartHoldem a place where innovation meets safety and sustainability. Our goal is to create an ecosystem that will serve as a foundation for other projects in the blockchain industry

SmartHoldem 2.0 includes new features and capabilities and a new philosophy. We invite you to join us on this journey to create a better future for all of us.

Welcome to the new era of SmartHoldem 2.0!

 

WHAT IS SMARTHOLDEM 2.0

SmartHoldem 2.0 is a next-generation open-source hybrid blockchain platform based on the world's first consensus mechanism with a unique combination of Delegated Proof of Stake (DPoS) and Proof of SpaceTime (PoSt) algorithms.

SmartHoldem 2.0 is a fundamental change in the platform's structure. It solves the well-known trilemma in the world of cryptocurrencies, consisting of three main tasks: security, scalability, and decentralization. SmartHoldem has found an approach that solves the blockchain trilemma without compromise.

Scalability
Scalability is a key aspect of blockchain technology development. It allows you to process a large number of transactions in a short time and provides efficient network operation.

The balance between transaction processing speed, dynamic fees, security and decentralization provides the necessary scalability for the efficient development of the SmartHoldem platform by growing demand.

Security

  • Proof of SpaceTime improves the overall security of the blockchain, increases resistance to “51% attacks”, and reduces the carbon footprint of any app deployed on SmartHoldem PoSt.
  • Delegated Proof of Stake works with Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT). This ensures that blocks are always completed and can never be returned.

Decentralization
Decentralization is fundamental in the world of blockchain technology.
SmartHoldem DPoS and PoSt blockchains are decentralized so that no single person or group has control—instead, all users collectively retain control. Decentralized blockchains are immutable, which means that the data entered is irreversible. Transactions are permanently recorded and viewable to anyone.

DPoS and PoSt are two consensus mechanisms. DPoS works with elected delegates who validate transactions and secure the network. This mechanism offers fast transaction speeds and scalability, making it suitable for high-throughput applications. PoSt is similar to Proof-of-Work (PoW), except PoSt participants contribute disk space instead of computation power to verify cryptographic proofs.

To harness the strengths of both mechanisms, SmartHoldem devs are working towards uniting DPoS and PoSt consensus within a single infrastructure. SmartHoldem aims to create a more robust and efficient blockchain network by combining the advantages of both mechanisms.

Combine of DPoS and PoSt consensus can offer several benefits:

Firstly, it can enhance the network's security through the unique Proof of SpaceTime (PoSt) consensus mechanism, which requires users to employ unused hard-drive space to coordinate block production and earn rewards. The PoSt network supports an unlimited number of nodes, where each node confirms blocks.

Secondly, in a DPoS network, validators are chosen through a decentralized democratic voting process. Delegates with a strong reputation are more likely to be elected as validators. Users maintain control over the system, meaning they can also remove delegates from Top validators if they work inefficiently.

This combined approach ensures that no single entity can monopolize the decision-making process or manipulate the network.

The integration of DPoS with PoSt can lead to improved scalability. DPoS's fast transaction speeds and ability to handle a large number of transactions can complement PoSt's energy-efficient validation process, enabling the network to process a higher volume of transactions without sacrificing security or decentralization.

SmartHoldem blockchains foster a more inclusive and participatory ecosystem. DPoS allows coin holders to elect delegates, giving them a voice in the network's governance. Combining this with POST consensus, where farmers/miners are directly linked to the ability to validate transactions, can achieve a more equitable distribution of power.

The integration of DPoS and PoSt consensus mechanisms within a single blockchain infrastructure holds great promise for the crypto community. Such integration addresses limitations and creates a more robust and efficient network.

SmartHoldem Delegated Proof-of-Stake (DPoS) is a fast, efficient, democratic, and flexible consensus.

SmartHoldem DPoS blockchain will include new types of transactions such as multiple payments, game transactions, multi-signatures, crypto-signatures, second passphrase, burn transactions, registration transactions, IPFS hash transactions, hashed time-lock contract (HTLC), Zero Knowledge Proofs transactions, delegate resignation and copyright registration.

The SmartHoldem DPoS upgrade will reduce the number of validators to 21, increasing the number of transactions per block and the speed of transaction processing. This enables the development of a wide range of apps, from decentralized exchanges to online games.

  • The delegate selection system will remain unchanged; the number of nodes isn’t limited. In the SmartHoldem network, the Top 21 Delegates are the main validators, performing transaction confirmation and adding new blocks.
  • Delegates can’t change or influence the transaction. Delegating can be compared to a system of democratic elections. Community members vote for the Nodes they want to see in the TOP 21.
  • Delegates for each block creation and validation round are selected randomly.
  • Any user can become a SmartHoldem delegate and earn rewards by developing, maintaining, and strengthening the network. To achieve this goal, you need to install the Node according to the technical requirements. 

4 PHASE SMARTHOLDEM 2.0

  • SmartHoldem 2.0 will be launched in 4 stages:
  • Phase 0 – SmartHoldem DPoS testnet launch (July 2023)
  • Public testnet stress test broadcast on SmartHoldem YouTube channel
  • Phase 1 - SmartHoldem DPoS mainnet launch (July-August 2023)
  • Infrastructure update (wallet, block explorer, API, documentation, platform website update, translations)

  • Phase 3 - SmartHoldem PoSt mainnet launch (2024)
